evidence.scope: Apple ProRaw source, Adobe Color selection and resulting raw profile
Curve copied to green and blue; their coordinates follow the observed copy operation. Channel endpoints remain at identity defaults 0/0 and 255/255.
Parametric highlights -10, lights +10, darks -50; untouched shadows and split boundaries omitted
Basic-panel final settings. Highlights -77, shadows +34 and whites -80 are intermediate values and were replaced in the video by -68, +24 and -77.
Blue HSL: hue -30, saturation -72; luminance untouched at 0 and omitted
Yellow HSL: hue -12, saturation -72; luminance untouched at 0 and omitted
Orange HSL: hue -6, saturation -30; luminance untouched at 0 and omitted
Color grading, cross-checked with the eight numeric values supplied by the user
Calibration: shadow tint +5, red hue +40, green hue +25, blue hue -25
Final case-specific exposure +0.30 and custom raw white balance 5903 K / tint +9

scope_notes: This file records the demonstrated case values, including its fixed exposure and white balance. It is not an adaptive preset.

Untouched zero-valued controls are omitted rather than reset: contrast, texture, dehaze, vibrance, global saturation, unused HSL controls, primary saturations, grading luminances and global grading controls.
No crop, geometry, sharpening, noise reduction, lens correction, mask, grain, export color space or process-version setting is written.
Curve Optimize Saturation and parametric split boundaries were not changed in the tutorial and are not written. Existing values in a target photo may therefore affect rendering.
The primary screenshot summary incorrectly assigns the luminance increase to blue and omits orange adjustments and red luminance. The preset follows the observed video panels.

Parameter extraction from video and XML readback are not Lightroom runtime validation. The generated preset has not been imported, shown in a Lightroom panel, applied to a photo, or read back from Lightroom.
